Why 60 + 24?

The 60-item profiler is completed first. The next follow-up is selected using answers already observed, after every response. It is not a fixed set of24 questions and no field choice locks out other careers. The experiment has a maximum of24 follow-ups. All2,000 models actually reached24 in both arms. It can stop if no eligible next question remains; no confidence-based stopping rule was tested. Lifestyle questions are separate.

Unknown interests stay unknown. These are fictional profiles; previously inspected holdouts are reported separately and do not establish student success.
